notes: Official ONELAN/Uniguest datasheet (via Eclipse Digital Media, an authorized reseller hosting the manufacturer PDF) describes the NTB-HDN-1 as a 1st Generation budget 4-zone fanless signage player, sold as NTB-HDN-1-S (standard) or NTB-HDN-1-S-W (with Wi-Fi). Video connectors are listed simply as "HDMI, DisplayPort" and "Ethernet 10/100/1000Base-T (RJ45)" with no explicit port counts, so single HDMI-out and single DisplayPort-out and single RJ45 are assumed (consistent with the product photo, which shows one visible rear I/O cluster). No HDMI/DP version or Ethernet speed grade is stated in the datasheet, so grade is omitted per instructions (spec does not state a version). Power is 12V/2A via an external PSU with mains cable (weight spec explicitly includes "PSU and mains cable"), so modeled as a dc-barrel input — the exact barrel size is not published. RS-232 port is a DB9 "COM" connector visible in the product photo. Two USB 3.0 (blue, SuperSpeed-marked, seen front-facing in product photo) and two USB 2.0 ports are listed; USB 2.0 port locations are not visible in the available photo angle but confirmed in the spec table. Optional internal M.2 Wi-Fi card (802.11 a/b/g/n) is not a physical port and is omitted. This is a compact fanless media-player box (116.6 x 107.4 x 30 mm) intended for VESA/back-of-screen mounting, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted.
